contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly of Constans (333-350), Soldier and hut issue of 348-350, Siscia mint, possibly RIC volume 8 no. 214, Reece period 18[?]. Obverse description: Bust left draped holding globe. Obverse inscription: DN[---]. Reverse description: Soldier dragging figure from hut below tree. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO].
